SELECT
  t4.region_name,
  COUNT(t0.session_id) as sessions
FROM app.sessions t0
JOIN app.devices t1 ON t1.device_uid = t0.device_uid
JOIN crm.player_accounts t2 ON t2.id = t1.owner_ref
JOIN crm.agents t3 ON t3.code = t2.agent_code
JOIN crm.regions t4 ON t4.no = t3.region_no
GROUP BY t4.region_name
ORDER BY t4.region_name

SELECT
  r.region_name,
  COUNT(*) as rejected_withdrawals
FROM fin.requests req
JOIN crm.player_accounts pa ON req.user_ref = pa.id
JOIN crm.agents ag ON pa.agent_code = ag.code
JOIN crm.regions r ON ag.region_no = r.no
WHERE req.type = 2 AND req.status = 3
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY r.region_name

SELECT
  a.agent_name,
  SUM(r.amount_cents) / 100.0 AS deposit_usd
FROM fin.requests r
JOIN crm.player_accounts p ON r.user_ref = p.id
JOIN crm.agents a ON p.agent_code = a.code
WHERE r.type = 1 AND r.status = 2
GROUP BY a.agent_name
ORDER BY a.agent_name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.member_ref) AS players
FROM game.bets b
JOIN game.rounds r ON b.round_ref = r.id
JOIN game.tables t ON r.tbl = t.table_no
JOIN game.games g ON t.g_code = g.code
JOIN game.vendors v ON g.vendor = v.vid
JOIN crm.player_accounts p ON b.member_ref = p.id
JOIN fin.requests f ON p.id = f.user_ref
WHERE v.vendor_name = 'Aurora Studios'
  AND f.type = 1
  AND f.status = 2

SELECT d.platform, COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) as sessions FROM fin.requests r INNER JOIN app.sessions s ON r.user_ref = s.player_id INNER JOIN app.devices d ON s.device_uid = d.device_uid WHERE r.status = 1 GROUP BY d.platform ORDER BY d.platform;

select v.vendor_name, sum(b.stake) / 100 as stake_usd
from game.bets b
join game.rounds r on r.id = b.round_ref
join game.tables t on t.table_no = r.tbl
join game.games g on g.code = t.g_code
join game.vendors v on v.vid = g.vendor
group by v.vendor_name;

SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(s.session_id) as sessions FROM app.sessions s JOIN crm.player_accounts p ON s.player_id = p.id JOIN crm.agents a ON p.agent_code = a.code JOIN crm.regions r ON a.region_no = r.no GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY r.region_name;

SELECT
  r.region_name,
  COUNT(*) as rejected_withdrawals
FROM fin.requests req
JOIN crm.player_accounts pa ON req.user_ref = pa.id
JOIN crm.agents a ON pa.agent_code = a.code
JOIN crm.regions r ON a.region_no = r.no
WHERE req.type = 2 AND req.status = 3
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY r.region_name;

SELECT
  a.agent_name,
  SUM(r.amount_cents) / 100.0 as deposit_usd
FROM fin.requests r
JOIN crm.player_accounts pa ON r.user_ref = pa.id
JOIN crm.agents a ON pa.agent_code = a.code
WHERE r.type = 1 AND r.status = 2
GROUP BY a.agent_name
ORDER BY a.agent_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.member_ref) as players
FROM game.bets b
JOIN game.rounds r ON b.round_ref = r.id
JOIN game.tables t ON r.tbl = t.table_no
JOIN game.games g ON t.g_code = g.code
JOIN game.vendors v ON g.vendor = v.vid
WHERE v.vendor_name = 'Aurora Studios'
AND b.member_ref IN (
    SELECT user_ref FROM fin.requests
    WHERE type = 1 AND status = 2
)

SELECT
  d.platform,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) as sessions
FROM app.sessions s
JOIN app.devices d ON s.device_uid = d.device_uid
WHERE s.player_id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_ref
  FROM fin.requests
  WHERE status = 1
)
GROUP BY d.platform
ORDER BY d.platform
